name: California
summary: California's SB 868 is signed and starts January 1, 2027. Certified devices up to 1,200 watts per dwelling will need no interconnection agreement. It does not override leases or HOA rules.

bill.name: Plug-in solar (reported as the "Plug Into the Sun Act")

watt_cap_note: Combined AC output of every plug-in device at one dwelling.
certification: Certified as a system by UL or an equivalent nationally recognized lab, with an anti-backfeed feature. Sources disagree on whether the statute names UL 3700.

utility.notification: Utilities may require a notice of use.

renters: No landlord override. Your lease controls, so get permission in writing.
notes: The exemption from interconnection rules expires January 1, 2030 unless extended.
Local permitting is not addressed; ask your city.
open_questions: Whether the chaptered text names UL 3700.

sources.title: SB 868 bill page, California Legislative Information
